messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI SAST/DAST job on several PRs returned partial results and the scanner marked findings as HIGH. Noticed a bunch of 429s in the job logs. Anyone already triaging? :eyes:

scanner-bot: CI job #4827 - sast-dast-run
status: completed (partial)
summary: 14 findings (8 confirmed, 6 heuristic-high from partial run)
logs:
```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] scan: starting
[2026-03-20T14:02:35Z] upload: artifacts -> scanner-vendor
[2026-03-20T14:03:02Z] vendor: 429 Too Many Requests
[2026-03-20T14:03:02Z] scan: incomplete, applying heuristic high severity for unmatched results
[2026-03-20T14:03:05Z] error: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE on artifact key id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd
```

alex: Noted. We saw the vendor throttle spike last night. The scanner treats incomplete runs as HIGH by default which is noisy. Looks like two things: rate-limiting from vendor + one artifact failed KMS decrypt so scanner couldn't verify evidence.

sam: Agreed we should NOT let partial/incomplete scans auto-block. Proposal:
1) Treat 'scan incomplete' as "needs-triage" label instead of HIGH severity in CI gating.
2) Auto-open a triage ticket with the raw logs and PR link.
3) Add PR-level annotation saying "scan incomplete — security triage required" so owners know.

jordan: Quick KMS note — that KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE usually means the CI runner role lost kms:Decrypt for the artifact bucket key after the RBAC change last week. Can someone confirm if the deploy-role was touched? I can pull CloudTrail but need an audit trail entry for RBAC change.

maya: @jordan good catch. I remember an RBAC tweak for the ephemeral-runner role (requested by infra) on 3/18. We should correlate that with CloudTrail. Also we should record any suppression/audit changes in the security audit log whenever we create a temporary suppression.

alex: For immediate mitigation I can flip a temporary policy to allow decrypt for the runner and re-run the scan. But we need an approved audit record before doing infra changes. Suggested short-run playbook:
- Create an audit ticket (SEC-XXXX) linking the PRs and logs
- Add a timeboxed suppress rule for these specific findings with reason "vendor rate-limit / incomplete run"
- Update CI gating config to treat incomplete runs as non-blocking and create triage alerts
- Re-run the jobs after KMS fix

sam: I can draft the audit ticket body and suppression reason. Should include: reproduction steps, raw logs, KMS ARN, affected PRs, and owner suggestion. Also add checklist for post-mortem if this recurs.

security-oncall: OK — I'll own the audit ticket and the suppression lifecycle. Creating SEC-2026-130 now and adding the current PRs. Also logging the RBAC change as part of the ticket. Will require 2 approvals (security + infra).

jordan: Thx. For the longer term: we should change scanner behavior or our adapter so vendor 429/incomplete -> "inconclusive" with a follow-up job instead of heuristic-high. That reduces noise and mistaken high severity labels. Also add a check that KMS decrypt failures escalate to infra change requests rather than auto-suppress.

maya: Action items:
- alex: temporary decrypt policy during re-run (please annotate infra PR and link to SEC-2026-130)
- sam: create suppression with justification draft
- jordan: pull CloudTrail entries and paste evidence in SEC-2026-130
- security-oncall: create SEC-2026-130 and assign approvals
- devex/ci-team: update gating rule to set "incomplete -> non-blocking + auto-triage" (we'll follow-up with a PR)

alex: Starting the infra change now, will comment the infra PR with the audit ticket and tag @security-oncall. Will not merge until approvals. :thumbsup:

security-oncall: SEC-2026-130 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-130 — added PR links, logs, and temp suppression draft. Please add evidence and approve when ready.

maya: Thanks everyone. After approvals let's run a small postmortem action item list: vendor quotas, retry/backoff in our scanner adapter, KMS permissions hardening, and gating rule update.

sam: I'll schedule a short 30-min sync for tomorrow to decide on the gating PR and suppression policy details.

jordan: Added CloudTrail snippets to the ticket. Looks like the ephemeral-runner role lost kms:Decrypt on 2026-03-18T22:04Z when infra applied a role-hardening patch.

alex: Re-run queued, scanning now. Will update thread when green or if more 429s show up.

scanner-bot: CI job #4828 - sast-dast-run (re-run)
status: in_progress

maya: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Keeping this thread for audit evidence.
